answer.action: Ensure all counterfeit notes are impounded, machine-processed, reported, and staff are trained according to these master directions.
answer.action_quote: A Master Direction incorporating and updating the extant guidelines/ instructions/ directives on the subject has been prepared to enable banks to have all current instructions on Counterfeit Notes at one place

effective_date.quote: The circulars listed in Annex IX and all Master Circulars / Directions earlier issued on the subject stand withdrawn from the date of issuance of this Master Direction.
